title: Aligned Delegates may not return any of their compensation to the holders who delegate to them
content:
A.1.6.5 is one sentence plus a consequence: "Aligned Delegates are not allowed to provide 'kickbacks' from their compensation to SKY holders who delegate to them. Violation of this requirement constitutes misalignment." A.1.6.6.1.2 reinforces it from the other direction by listing "acceptance of undisclosed compensation (kickbacks) for governance actions" among Tier 2 integrity breaches, which trigger immediate derecognition regardless of prior record.

The rule is doing something specific and necessary given how Ranked Delegate seats are awarded. Level 3 rank — and its budget — goes automatically to the ADs with the greatest delegated SKY (A.1.6.4.1.3.3). Without a kickback ban, that formula becomes an auction: a delegate could rebate part of the budget to attract delegation, use the increased delegation to secure or hold rank, and fund the rebate from the rank's budget. The equilibrium is delegates competing on payout rate rather than on judgment, with the protocol's own money financing the competition.

Banning kickbacks preserves the informational content of delegation. Delegated SKY is meant to signal *which delegates holders trust*, and that signal is what the Level 3 formula reads. Once delegation can be purchased, the signal measures willingness to pay and the automatic ranking mechanism starts selecting the wrong delegates — while looking exactly the same from outside.

It also protects the SKY holder's own interest. A holder choosing a delegate for a rebate is being paid to stop exercising judgment about who governs, which is precisely the failure the Alignment Conserver concept exists to prevent: A.0.1.1.17 frames ACs as making it easy for holders to act in their long-term interest even with little alignment. A rebate makes the misaligned choice the profitable one.
description: A.1.6.5 makes kickbacks misalignment outright, and A.1.6.6.1.2 lists undisclosed compensation as a Tier 2 integrity breach carrying immediate derecognition.
